acceptance: pi_rpc_process.rs exposes PiRpcProcess::spawn(program: &Path, args: &[String], cwd: &Path) -> io::Result<PiRpcProcess> that starts the child with piped stdin/stdout/stderr and does not use a shell

A reader thread splits stdout on LF only (strip one optional preceding CR; do NOT split on U+2028/U+2029), parses each line as serde_json::Value, and delivers records on a std::sync::mpsc channel; a non-JSON line is delivered as an Error variant, not dropped and not a panic; EOF delivers an Exited variant once
A stderr reader keeps a bounded tail (last 4 KiB) readable via a method, and never feeds stderr into the record channel

send(&mut self, command_type: &str, fields: serde_json::Value) -> Result<String, String> writes one JSON object plus LF with a fresh unique string id and returns the id; the caller correlates the matching {type:response,id} record itself
close_stdin() requests orderly shutdown; Drop closes stdin, waits briefly, then kills the child, and never leaves a zombie

tests/fixtures/fake_pi_rpc.js is a small node script that behaves like pi --mode rpc: for get_state echoes a success response with the same id and a fixed sessionId; for prompt replies {started} then emits agent_start, one message_update text_delta, agent_end, agent_settled; for abort replies success then emits a message_end with stopReason aborted then agent_settled; exits 0 when stdin closes; one scripted line containing U+2028 inside a JSON string must arrive as ONE record

pi_rpc_process_tests.rs spawns the fake via node and covers: response id correlation, event order through agent_settled, U+2028 stays one record, non-JSON line becomes Error, stdin close exits the child with Exited delivered exactly once, Drop reaps the child
mod.rs only gains module declarations; #![allow(dead_code)] with a comment at the top of pi_rpc_process.rs as in pi_rpc_map.rs; no existing item changed; no existing test file modified
user_request: Add a standalone Pi RPC process module for the web session adapter: spawn pi --mode rpc as a child, read its stdout as strict LF-delimited JSONL onto a channel, write id-correlated commands to stdin, and ship a fake pi child script for tests. No wiring into the live session path; a later task builds the connection loop on top.
instructions: Read AGENTS.md and docs/agent/rust.md first, then read ONLY these for context: crates/ajax-web/src/adapters/web_session_acp/pi_rpc_map.rs (sibling module, same style), crates/ajax-web/src/adapters/web_session_acp/client.rs (how AcpStdioClient spawns/reaps its child and uses threads and std mpsc), crates/ajax-web/tests/fixtures/fake_acp.js (existing fake child style), and .planning/packets/claude-agent-sdk-pi-rpc/pi-rpc-findings.md (real Pi RPC protocol). Use std threads and std::sync::mpsc like client.rs, not tokio. Keep every Rust file under 600 lines. Do not commit. Stop and report BLOCKED if a file outside scope is needed.
revision_findings: A previous Qwen round left pi_rpc_process.rs, pi_rpc_process_tests.rs and tests/fixtures/fake_pi_rpc.js in the tree. Continue from them; fix rather than rewrite where they are sound.
mod.rs does NOT declare the new modules, so pi_rpc_process.rs has never been compiled. Add `mod pi_rpc_process;` and `#[cfg(test)] mod pi_rpc_process_tests;` next to the existing pi_rpc_map lines.

pi_rpc_process.rs will not compile: `object.insert("id".to_owned(), Value::String(id.clone())));` has an extra `)`; `ChildStdin` has no `.close()` (hold stdin in an Option<ChildStdin> and `take()`/drop it to close); `mpsc::Sender::is_closed()` does not exist on std mpsc (just ignore send errors, and break the loop when send returns Err).

Framing bug: `line.strip_suffix('
').and_then(|r| r.strip_suffix('')).unwrap_or(&line)` returns the line WITH its trailing '
' whenever there is no ''. Strip '
' first, then an optional '' separately. read_line must also not be used if it can fail on invalid UTF-8; use read_until(b'
') on bytes and String::from_utf8_lossy so U+2028/U+2029 and bad bytes never break framing.

pi_rpc_process_tests.rs contains NO tests: its require_node() calls std::process::abort() and which_node() always returns None. Delete that scaffolding. Write real #[test]s that spawn `node` (std::process::Command::new("node")) with args [path-to-fake_pi_rpc.js] where the path is built from env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"). If node is missing the tests should fail loudly, not abort or silently skip.

Required tests (all must exist and pass): response id correlation (send get_state -> the Record with the same id and type response); prompt event order through agent_settled; a U+2028 inside a JSON string stays ONE record; a non-JSON line is delivered as PiRpcRecord::Error; close stdin -> Exited delivered exactly once and the channel then disconnects; dropping the process reaps the child (verify the pid is gone after drop, e.g. via `kill -0` through Command, or by checking try_wait before drop on a child that exited).
Check fake_pi_rpc.js against the acceptance list (get_state, prompt, abort, exits on stdin close, one scripted U+2028 line) and fix gaps; run `node --check` on it.

Do not leave `#![allow(dead_code)]`-style placeholders other than the single documented one at the top of pi_rpc_process.rs. Keep every Rust file under 600 lines. Run the full verify list and report real results.
